div.head: Iud Dei VIII 1
div.ab: Ic eow halsie þurh ðonne Fæder ⁊ þone Sunu ⁊ þone Halgan gast ⁊ þurh heowerne cristendóm, þe ge uiiderfengon, ⁊ þurh þa halgan rode, þe Crist on ðrowode, ⁊ þurh þa halgan godspel ⁊ ða reliquias, þe on ðisse cyrcan syndon,

I adjure you by the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit, and by the Christianity which you have received, and by the holy Cross on which Christ suffered, and by the holy Gospels and the relics which are in this church,
